newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing Lightbus sees 96 net profit from 95 loss.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Lightbus sees 96 net profit from 95 loss.

text.p: Truckmaker Beijing Lightbus forecast a full-year 1996 net profit of 1.5 million yuan, up from an actual full 1995 loss of 31.5 million yuan, the company said on Tuesday.
In a report of half-year 1996 earnings, the company said it posted a net profit of 0.53 million yuan, against a loss of 1.34 million in the same 1995 period.

On August 9, the company's shareholders voted to use 50 million yuan from its reserve funds to set against operating losses of 31.5 million yuan in 1995 and operating losses of 18.4 million yuan in the first four months of 1996, it said.

Turnover in first half 1996 fell to 94 million yuan from 189.284 million in the first half of 1995 because of restrictions on the use of trucks by the Beijing city government early in 1996 and restrictions on purchases of trucks, it said.
In the first half of 1996, net assets per share fell to 1.69 yuan from 1.99 yuan in the same 1995 period and earnings per share were 0.003 yuan, against minus 0.008 yuan, it said.
Isuzu and ITOCHU purchased a 25 percent stake in Beijing Lightbus last year, turning the company into a joint venture.
